research.name: UVCanvas
research.note: React library of WebGL shader canvases for animated gradient backgrounds, several adapted from Shadertoy and Stripe.

effects: Drop-in shader canvas components such as Lumiflex, Zenitho, Novatrix and Velustro rendering animated gradients

unverified: The source is public at github.com/latentcat/uvcanvas (no license file detected); that repository has not been researched in place of this site yet.
Most shaders are credited on the site as forks from Shadertoy, Stripe or an ogl example, so the effects are adapted rather than original.
The site changelog lists versions without dates; the date is the Release 0.3.0 commit in the repository.
